title: Immigration debate ‘dividing us’, incoming archbishop of Canterbury warns in Christmas sermon
summary: Sarah Mullally says ‘national conversations… continue to divide us when our common humanity should unite us’ The incoming archbishop of Canterbury has warned in her Christmas Day sermon that “our national conversations about immigration continue to divide us, when our common humanity should unite us”. Acting in her current role as the bishop of London, Dame Sarah Mullally told St Paul’s Cathedral: “Joy is born exactly where despair expects to triumph.
